comments.kingdomoftime: Two starts since handicapping solid; latest effort can be marked up too; shortlisted

comments.localbay: Serial hard-puller who's done his winning after a recent run; may be best watched today
comments.paradoxical: 3-3 in cheekpieces; penalty will make things tougher but he could well be up to it
comments.urbanroad: Another improved effort over C&D three days ago in a race not run to suit; leading claims
comments.urbansprawl: Still to win after 14 AW starts; pulled hard when turning in a rare poor effort latest

comments.ashwednesday: Highly progressive at 7f on Tapeta before return to sprinting didn't work out latest
comments.capuchinero: Losing AW run goes back to late 2023 but her C&D second last month has been franked since
comments.everdriven: Soundly beaten on handicap debut as 3yo; had wind op since; cheekpieces on; risky
comments.kristalklear: Found her feet in 7f Tapeta handicaps last year; excuses since; should go well
comments.lequinto: Three wins at 7f and 1m here; runs over sprint trips now; first 7f run for over 2 years
comments.letterofthelaw: 0-13 on AW and looks unlikely back from break over inadequate trip
comments.macanudo: Acts here but yet to win a handicap and hasn't run over 7f since his 2yo days
comments.soarabove: Out of sorts but more promising at Kempton latest; all eight AW wins on that track
comments.southdakotasioux: 2-2 over C&D since the autumn; solid effort in defeat at Kempton latest; good claims
comments.triggered: Two C&D wins in 2023; up and down over the last 12 months but close up here latest

verdict.comment: This might go to OCEAN ODYSSEY, who drops in grade after making the frame in a Lingfield handicap on his stable debut

comments.alicesimpact: In the frame all four starts for new stable this year; shortlisted
comments.comedianleader: Regressive mare; dips into this basement grade for first time; others appeal more
comments.dourado: Inconsistent veteran; back in the doldrums since 20-1 handicap second in September
comments.fiftysent: Placed three times in this grade on Tapeta in recent weeks; likely contender again
comments.inexplicable: Not one to rely upon nowadays but this multiple C&D winner is capable in this grade
comments.limmortale: 0-16 in Ireland but was placed in Dundalk handicap in January; a possible on stable debut
comments.oceanodyssey: Ran quite well when fourth in Lingfield handicap on stable debut and drops in grade today
comments.scarfo: Shade disappointing over 7f last time but has twice made the frame over C&D this year
comments.youareeverything: Unlucky over 7f here two runs ago but below form since and now 0-18
comments.zumaaty: Returned from break with fairly good fourth here (9.4f) last month; could have a say

races.raceComment: dourado is marginally preferred with a score of 45.9%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and superior course form over fiftysent. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
